title: SSE and WebSocket have no timeout; hardcoded 30s on HTTP calls is not configurable
description: subscribe_events and connect_ws have no idle or connect timeout. fetch_session and call hardcode 30 seconds. Neither is configurable by the caller. A hung SSE connection silently stalls the stream with no error — callers get no signal to reconnect. The 30s HTTP timeout is appropriate for most cases but embedding servers (embedded devices, high-latency links) will need to change it. Adding a timeout parameter later requires a breaking API change. This will generate recurring 'client hangs forever' issue reports.
